reference.text: Perhaps I did not always love him so well as I do now; but in such cases as these a good memory is unpardonable.

underlines.text: But will they make you happy?

reference.text: “My dear, dear Lizzy, I would, I do congratulate you; but are you certain—forgive the question—are you quite certain that you can be happy with him?”
